According to MoSPI's NSS 2025 survey, a typical private‑hospital stay costs ₹24,000 (≈$248) out of pocket, with the average at ₹50,508 (≈$522). In 2022–23, households paid about 43% of all health spending in India directly out of pocket. Does that make keeping savings aside feel riskier to you?

Individual health insurance premiums have had no GST since September 2025, while employer group policies still pay 18% (C19). The average health claim paid in 2024–25 was about ₹28,900 (≈$299) (C21). What concerns you most about paying a premium versus facing a claim?
